<h1>Good Practice Guide on Emissivity Conversion Published</h1>

<p>The <strong><em>Good practice guide on the conversion of near-normal directional emissivity into hemispherical emissivity with a target uncertainty below 5&nbsp;% (2.5&ndash;50&nbsp;&micro;m)</em></strong> has been published by the PaRaMetriC consortium (EPM project 21GRD03; PTB, CAE, RISE, FIW M&uuml;nchen, LNE, INRIM; 11 authors including J. Manara and C. Monte). It was released on Zenodo on 30 September 2025.</p>

<p>This guide addresses one of the most common practical challenges in emissivity measurement: how to reliably convert near-normal directional emissivity into hemispherical emissivity, with a target uncertainty below 5&nbsp;% over the 2.5&ndash;50&nbsp;&micro;m range.</p>

<p>The guide is freely available on Zenodo and represents an important step toward standardized practices in our field.</p>

<p><a href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17684770">Read the Good Practice Guide on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17684770)</a></p>
